## The National Ignition Facility’s Target-Level Energy Result

The National Ignition Facility experiment achieved fusion ignition, producing 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy after 2.05 megajoules were delivered to the target. On this target-level comparison, the fusion output exceeded the energy delivered to the target.

The result is progress toward inertial fusion energy, not practical electricity production. Substantial scientific and technological development is still required for practical energy production.
